subject: Executing Chains From Different STAN Models in Parallel

messages.author: ac21cfdea1c4d924
messages.subject: Executing Chains From Different STAN Models in Parallel
parts:
Hello,

I am new to STAN (~2 months now) and use the R interface.  In my research I am often faced with the task of running and comparing multiple time series models in real-time. 

One feature that I think would save me a considerable amount of computation time would be if I could run chains from different STAN models in parallel.  Is there anyway to do this using the R interface? or any plans to develop such a feature in the future?

Thank you!

messages.author: 3f22b207863d2049
messages.subject: Re: Executing Chains From Different STAN Models in Parallel
parts: This feature is already available in R. Check out the Quick start guide.

messages.author: 3f22b207863d2049
messages.subject: Re: Executing Chains From Different STAN Models in Parallel
parts: Ah apologies, I misread. Parallel execution of different models. No idea...
